summary: New Cape Cod method page mirrors the ResQ Generalised Cape Cod editor with Details, Method, Ultimates, Ratios, Notes, and Audit Log tabs.
details: Method tab selects a Latest triangle, Exposure vector, and Prior Ultimate vector (Latest / Ultimates or Pattern mode) and computes every ResQ-verified derived column with a Total row, trend rate fit/auto-fit, decay factor, scaling, decimal places, and per-origin trend factor overrides.
Ultimates tab shows the as-if diagnostic ultimates triangle and the Ratios tab plots the six Cape Cod ratio series.

Cape Cod opens from the Home launch cards and from Project Instance rows (Add -> Cape Cod on eligible vector rows), with floating-window state, active tab, dirty-close handshake, and CC@ method JSON resolution wired like Bornhuetter Ferguson.
